scope: Explicit scenario-author exposed surface beaching, plus qualified source3.4 surface grounding; submerged bottom grounding not inferred.

execution_policy.capacity: Retain immutable listed hp_max as original DP for percentage casualties; add one original-DP destruction reserve to actual remaining hp while beached, so all shared DP sinks see the same2x capacity. Refloat removes the reserve, does not heal actual damage.
execution_policy.small_craft: The explicit beached destruction reserve is consumed by committed DP; do not allow the ordinary F/G tactical damage window to delete that reserve. Critical catastrophes remain separate from DP exhaustion.
execution_policy.movement: Exposed grounded/beached vessel held at actual position. Source3.4 freeing timer remains; strict damage>listed forbids actual refloat. Intentional refloat command requires declared author completion authorization, no universal zero-duration work implied.
